create_representation_subclass: create a subclass of RepresentationBase that implements forward and _preprocess_inputs methods
init_representation_base: initialize a RepresentationBase instance with a config object to set representation_dim to None
get_representation_dim: call get_representation_dim on a RepresentationBase subclass instance to retrieve the representation dimension
implement_forward_method: implement the forward method in a RepresentationBase subclass to process inputs and return representations
implement_preprocess_inputs: implement _preprocess_inputs in a RepresentationBase subclass to preprocess input data before the forward pass
